snippet.title: FLASK - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
FLASK is a roguelike autobattler about alchemical greed on the new frontier with a brilliantly weird visual style created by artist John Kenn Mortensen. Build unstoppable homunculi, barter with mutated merchants, and slay hordes of monsters to harvest their valuable blood. It's time to get bloody... Bloody rich!

WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3714280/FLASK/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description&utm_campaign=reveal_trailer

Developed by Chop Chop Games
Published by Ghost Ship Publishing
